description: Defines a template class 'Interpolator' for spline interpolation, used for volume shaping in Android media. Implements various spline types, caching, and parcelable serialization.

classes.name: Interpolator
classes.description: A template class for spline interpolation supporting step, linear, cubic, and monotonic types, with caching and parceling capabilities.

methods.name: findY
methods.description: Finds the Y value corresponding to a given X using the selected interpolation method.

methods.name: setInterpolatorType
methods.description: Sets the type of interpolation (step, linear, cubic, etc.).

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the interpolator to a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes the interpolator from a Parcel.
